versions.changelog: Add auto-ensure-session (self-drive one-time device login; no auth dead-stop).

Initial release of ship-paid-app — deploy a live full-stack app in one command.

- Instantly deploys apps to a public URL with SettleMesh login, managed database, runtime API key, and billing pre-wired.
- Supports Node, Python/FastAPI/Django, Go, static, Next.js, or any Dockerfile-based app.
- Requires the settlemesh CLI and SETTLE_API_KEY.
- Simplifies setup: no need for separate accounts for hosting, database, authentication, or billing.
- Includes flexible CLI flags for common deployment scenarios.
- Integrates secret management and environment variable handling out of the box.
